title: A leg's start clears only runs that wrote a status: a killed run turns the cache bound off, and a leg ref with no run is kept
body:
## What is wrong

Each leg start clears the project's ended runs at other commits from the host (issue 0367: `_release_leg_clear_ended`, lib/release.legs:524, called at :593). It finds them in the bare repo's `git worktree list` (:378) and takes only a run with its `.rc` beside it (`_release_leg_remote_ended`, :375-389; the test is at :385). Two leftovers are never cleared.

1. A run killed before it writes its `.rc`, eg by a host reboot, an out-of-memory kill or a full disk. Its worktree stays with no status. At every later start of that project, the cache bound reads such a worktree as a run still going and leaves the cache as it stands (`_release_leg_remote_start`, :274-284). So one killed run turns the bound off on that host until a person removes the run. A full disk can stop the status write itself (:331 needs a free block), so the run that meets a full disk is one that leaves no status, and the cache that filled the disk then has no bound.

2. A leg ref, `refs/devbin/legs/<sha>`, whose worktree is gone. release_leg_start pushes the ref before the host makes the worktree (:599). A start that stops after the push leaves the ref with no worktree: when git cannot make the worktree (:269-272), when the host refuses and removes the worktree it made (:303-310), or when ssh fails at the start (:608-612). The sweep reads worktrees only, so it never sees such a ref. The runner's own clear deletes a run's ref with its worktree (`_release_leg_remote_clear`, :398-420, the ref at :412), so a ref with no worktree is a run half cleared. The runner should delete it: every `refs/devbin/legs/<sha>` with no worktree, except the start's own. Both parts are in one issue because one change to the start's sweep covers both.

## What it costs

Part 1: the gates' cache grows past `release.gate_cache.max` on that host, run after run, until the disk fills, and a leg fails for a reason that is not in the release. I14a851d is the other way the cache passes its bound: the bound acts only when a run starts, so one run can add several GiB to a cache that started within it.

Part 2: the bare repo keeps a commit and its objects that no run needs. The cost is small, since a later commit or a sent tag shares most of the objects.

## What the record shows

From the leg logs copied back to rhadamanth (release_leg_dir, tmp/release/legs/kovacs in each checkout), read 2026-11-26 14:48Z by date -u:

- Part 1 is latent. No log shows the skip. Intent: 20 logs, 12 of them since the bound came in (0361-1, 2026-11-16), each with its bound line: 10 kept and 2 emptied. devbin: 20 logs, 11 with a bound line, all kept.
- kovacs-sysadm read ~/work/intent-leg.cache at 15G at 14:46Z by its clock, with no leg run directory left (relayed by devbin-vc). That is I14a851d's mechanism, not a skipped bound. Intent's last leg on record, at 0bab786dc32d (2026-11-26), found the cache at 10487180 KiB, within its bound of 12582912 KiB, so that run took it from 10.0 GiB to about 15G. Between consecutive starts on record, the cache grew by as much as 5.9 GiB (a cold build) and 4.1 GiB (a warm run).
- Part 2 is on the host now. kovacs-sysadm's read at 14:46Z found 5 refs under refs/devbin/legs/ in ~/work/devbin-leg.git with no worktree: the release commits of v0.1.20 (2bf02f25) and v0.1.21 (9b674c0e), and three v0.1.23 cut attempts (ed87fd32, 10a45fd2, c13c101a), from 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-12. All are older than 0367 (v0.1.27). How their worktrees went is not on the record here.

## The question

The fix is open. One shape: the start's sweep also clears a run with no status when no process of it is alive on the host, and deletes every leg ref with no worktree except its own. A run with no status and a live process stays, as now. cc is authoritative on what a leg's state means.

## Scope

No code yet. This joins the list for the next devbin release (devbin-vc's word, 2026-11-26 14:46Z by date -u). Related: I14a851d.

## Provenance

Found by devbin-dc, 2026-11-26 14:41Z by date -u, reading lib/release.legs at fc9f72ae for devbin-vc's question about kovacs's disk. The facts from kovacs are kovacs-sysadm's, relayed by devbin-vc. The leg logs were read on rhadamanth; nothing was run. Filed by devbin-dc on devbin-vc's word, 2026-11-26 14:48Z by date -u.

## Resolution

Fixed for the next devbin release. The fix landed at 806827f5 on main, on I14a851d's 2f67827c, as unit I0a62f4a.

Fix, to cc's word on what a run's state and a leg ref mean (2026-11-26 18:35Z and 18:43Z): _release_leg_run_state is the one test of a run's state. The start's bound, its sweep and the probe each read it. A run is ended once its status is there, going while its runner is alive, and gone once the runner is gone and the status is still absent, read in that order. The runner is found by its command line, which every runner since v0.1.19 ends with ` release-leg <worktree>`, read from `ps -A -ww -o args=`. No file is read for it, since a full disk that stops the status can stop any write.

Part 1: a gone run at any commit, the start's own included, is cleared as an ended run. Its log first gets a last line that says its runner was gone, and when, by the host's clock. Then its log is copied back, the run is cleared, and one warn line names it. A read of a gone run answers unknown, naming it and the gates' last line. The start bounds the cache and makes the TMPDIR before its worktree add, so only the log's header lies between the add and the runner's launch.

Part 2: the start's sweep prunes the worktrees git lists with their directory gone. Then it deletes each refs/devbin/legs/<commit> that no run's worktree holds, except its own. The first devbin leg start on kovacs with this runner deletes the 5 stale refs in devbin-leg.git: 2bf02f25, 9b674c0e, ed87fd32, 10a45fd2 and c13c101a.

Not in this fix: a lock against two starts of one project on one host at once. The Desk keeps such starts apart, as vc's watchout says, and a lock would be a unit of its own, on hv's word.

Proof off the Desk: probe-arms2.sh ran the five I0a62f4a arms. Each was red at 666d1869 and green at the tip, and all 21 releaselegs arms were green at the tip.

Desk proof, slot 01M8CKDPKPDYKA48FZSGREB6F8, 2026-11-26 18:57Z to 19:08Z, at 3ed599dc. At the base, the five I0a62f4a arms read not ok, each for its own reason. At the tip, releaselegs.bats read 21 of 21 ok, and the 25 releasecut arms that run legs read 25 of 25. Test scans read 61 ok, and lint read 59 files and 0 breaches.
